library.title: Media library
library.lead: Images in this project. Uploads are converted to JPEG or PNG, because other formats fail to render in some mail clients.
library.count: {count, plural, =0 {No images} one {# image} other {# images}}
library.countFiltered: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing matched} one {# match} other {# matches}}
library.countUnused: {count, plural, =0 {all are in use} one {# unused} other {# unused}}
library.loadFailed: The library could not be loaded.

empty.title: No images yet
empty.explanation: Drag images into the area above, or pick them with the button. Saved images go into an email through the Image block.
empty.filteredExplanation: Try a shorter term. The search covers the file name and the image description.

upload.hint: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, AVIF or SVG. WebP, AVIF and SVG are converted. At most {limit} per file.
upload.done: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing was uploaded} one {# image uploaded} other {# images uploaded}}
upload.duplicate: {name}: this image is already in the library

errors.asset_unsupported_format: This format cannot be uploaded. Use JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, AVIF or SVG.
errors.asset_corrupt: The file could not be read as an image.
errors.asset_too_many_pixels: The image has too many pixels. Scale it down and try again.
errors.asset_quota_exceeded: This project has run out of image storage.
errors.asset_referenced_by_sent_campaign: The image is used by a campaign that has already been sent.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.tooLargeLocal: The file is larger than {limit}, so it was never sent to the server.
errors.wrongTypeLocal: The library does not accept this file type.
errors.unknown: That did not work. Please try again.

tile.open: Open the image in a new tab

usage.loading: Checking where the image is used

selection.bar: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing selected} one {# image selected} other {# images selected}}

delete.title: {count, plural, =0 {Delete images} one {Delete # image} other {Delete # images}}
delete.safeLead: The images disappear from the library. The file stays on disk for 30 days, so nothing breaks in emails that already went out.
delete.usedLead: Some of the selected images are in use. Deleting them breaks the reference and leaves an empty spot in drafts.
delete.blockedLead: The image is used by a campaign that has already been sent. Recipients have it in their inbox and deleting it would remove it from their email.
delete.confirmUnderstood: I understand the references will break
delete.resultOk: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing was deleted} one {# image deleted} other {# images deleted}}
delete.resultFailed: {count, plural, =0 {} one {# image could not be deleted} other {# images could not be deleted}}
